import pytest


def pick(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> int:
    """Deterministically pick an element from a non-empty list using seed."""
    if not xs:
        raise ValueError("xs must not be empty")
    return xs[seed % len(xs)]


def test_pick_deterministic() -> None:
    data = [10, 20, 30, 40]
    assert pick(data, 0) == pick(data, 0)
    assert pick(data, 1) == 20
    assert pick(data, 4) == 10


def test_pick_single_element() -> None:
    assert pick([42], 0) == 42
    assert pick([42], 7) == 42
    assert pick([42], -3) == 42


def test_pick_negative_seed() -> None:
    data = [10, 20, 30]
    assert pick(data, -1) == 30
    assert pick(data, -2) == 20


def test_pick_empty_raises() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        pick([], 0)
